description:
### Fixed
- The Nuvio button now opens Nuvio in its own entry in the app switcher, instead of appearing merged into Letterboxd's task.

### Changed
- Refactored the Stremio/Nuvio launch code to share one helper for targeting a package, giving it its own task, and falling back to the web player, instead of repeating that logic three times.
- Simplified the internal app-selection logic from a three-state enum down to a boolean, since the third state was never actually treated differently anywhere. No user-facing behavior change beyond the task-switcher fix above.
